data.other_hard: Must have non-U.S. residency status and be applying from a school outside the United States; English proficiency required for non-U.S. citizens whose first language is not English (TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo); high school GPA between 3.5 and 4.0
data.evidence_sentence: Must have non-U.S. residency status and be applying from a school outside the United States.
data.notes: Page lists several awards (#YouAreWelcomeHere, President's, Provost's, Dean's, 1855, Beaumont Tower, Global Community) with different annual amounts; the amounts are tuition grants, so funding is partial. Page says Eligible Countries is All Countries but eligibility text requires non-U.S. residency, so nationality is recorded as INTERNATIONAL. The GPA 3.5-4.0 is stated as a high school GPA requirement for freshmen, scale not stated. Page also says ACT/SAT scores are optional for some and competitive. Page text is a third-party summary; the deadline of November 1, 2026 is listed as the closing date. Rolling consideration of remaining awards after November 1 is mentioned in the text but the listed deadline is 2026-11-01. Related scholarship links in page are unrelated and ignored. Page title says 'for International Students' while text refers to 'international undergraduate' scholarships; the 2026 intake is referenced.
